In Hanna (2008), several models with dense gas capabilities were used to simulate actual atmospheric dispersals from train rail car accidents, all involving chlorine gas. Although downwind measurements, which would serve as a benchmark, were not available, validation of the EPIcode results could be ascertained through comparison with results from other dispersion models.
